text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Did that voice come from here? ...Or<n>from behind the
statues?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I dunno who you are, but ya got a<n>long way to go
before you'll ever be<n>able to pull a prank on me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Now give it up and show yourself<n>already!
